reviewAssignments.details: Blocking finding F-0001: interrupted task creation may duplicate the task on retry.

findings.summary: Interrupted task creation can create a duplicate
findings.details: A failed or interrupted create can be recovered and then retried as a second task, leaving an unintended duplicate plan entry and returning a different ID. TaskService.ts:31-57 always allocates and writes a new task after entering the transaction. WorkspaceTransaction.ts:37,115-166 first replays any pending ledger write and commits it before the operation runs. Unlike TicketService.ts:43,99-114, task creation does not inspect recovered writes to recognize its already-recovered operation. Existing task tests do not exercise this recovery path. Make an interrupted task-create retry recognize the recovered creation and return its original ID without creating another task. Add an interruption/recovery regression test, while retaining distinct IDs for genuinely separate creates.
